headline: Meta's Muse Wonder models are its first attempt at a frontier model
body: Meta's Superintelligence Lab released Muse Wonder and Muse Wonder Full on Monday. According to Meta's testing, both achieve comparable benchmark scores to Fable 5.1 and GPT-6 Astra. Wonder will cost $4 per million input tokens and $20 per million output tokens through the Meta Model API, while Wonder Full will only be available to Muse Code subscribers.
note: For teams weighing model costs, TechCrunch reports that Wonder is roughly equivalent in cost to GPT-6 Sol or Opus 5.5. The benchmark comparison comes from Meta's own testing.

evidence.text: Meta's Superintelligence Lab released a pair of new state-of-the-art models on Monday, Muse Wonder and Muse Wonder Full, representing the company's first attempt at a frontier model.
According to Meta's testing (presented in the model card ), Wonder and Wonder Full achieve comparable benchmark scores to Fable 5.1 and GPT-6 Astra.
Accessed through the Meta Model API, Wonder will cost $4 per million input tokens and $20 per million output tokens, making it roughly equivalent in cost to GPT-6 Sol or Opus 5.5.
Notably, Wonder Full will only be available to Muse Code subscribers and will not be served through the API.
